title: Add an MCP Connector and Pi tools
what: Discover/call granted tools on operator-configured remote MCP servers. Use a Connector without adding origin dependencies or a second agent loop to Core.

acceptance.text: Use the official Streamable HTTP SDK for tools/list and tools/call
Enforce both server policy and conversation tool grants
Support secret-referenced headers, cancellation, deadlines, response limits, and redirect rejection
Verify authorized DO/Pi calls and denied tool dispatch
Document configuration and unsupported features such as interactive OAuth
